meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

copy.tagline: 通过二维码或配对码直连 WhatsApp 频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中直接连接 WhatsApp 发送或接收消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel via QR code or pairing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to directly connect WhatsApp in your app to send or receive messages.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 就能接入 WhatsApp 频道：通过二维码或配对码绑定手机，之后可在 WhatsApp 上收发消息。它还会根据你用的是专用还是共享号码，决定陌生人消息是否需审批、出站消息是否加名字前缀等。
howto.when: 当用户提出要接入 WhatsApp、需要绑定设备或认证号码时，这个技能会接手执行安装与配置流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can add a WhatsApp channel: it connects directly to WhatsApp Web via the Baileys adapter, authenticates with a QR code or pairing code, and then adapts its behavior (mention signals, approval, name prefix) depending on whether the number is dedicated or shared.
howto.when_en: This skill triggers when the user asks to add WhatsApp as a channel, or needs to link a device / authenticate a number as part of that setup.

say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and guides authentication

Shows the risk warning and confirmation flow
